rationale: Despite gapping up and trending strongly above VWAP ($18.99) on 4.02x relative volume, CYRX has entered a midday lull with 1-minute volume drying up (680 shares on the most recent bar) and a wide bid-ask spread of 25.9 bps ($0.05), representing nearly 40% of a 5-minute ATR ($0.1273). Price is currently slipping slightly below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($19.33), offering neither a high-momentum breakout trigger for a long nor sufficient reversal confirmation to fade the dominant uptrend short. Given the high transaction cost relative to intraday volatility and limited remaining daily loss budget ($320.55), standing aside is optimal.
